readerCopy.body: Long-standing emotional baggage comes into the open without the conversation becoming a fight. Grief, anxiety, or an old family loyalty can be discussed without forcing anyone to reveal more than they are ready to share. The Moon registers the emotional history, while Pluto brings silence, fear, loyalty, and control into view. Under the trine, honesty moves through the room without turning vulnerability into a weapon. The conversation may feel safer than expected, but what surfaces could change how everyone understands the past.
